name: Luci
source:
Said to have suddenly appeared around 50,000 years ago, the nameless archdemon quickly rose to power in Hell's hierarchy. She caught many demons' attention due to her power, and if you know anything about Hell, that's not a good thing.

By the time she had conquered [url=https://vndb.org/c131916]Asmodeus[/url]' domain for herself, the other lords of Hell had already started rallying their forces for an all-out war in defense of their territory. They prepared for an attack, but it never came, Luci had turned her attention elsewhere. Now that she had claim over a domain in Hell, she began to consort with the Old Ones.

Luci's time helping the Old Ones was... weird to say the least. Though she was quick to kill demons, when it came to others, she had a bad habit of playing around with them. This cost [url=https://vndb.org/c131888]Dagon[/url] dearly when she sent Luci to kill Baron Samedi, a god aiding the Oathbound, but she toyed with him until he escaped.

[In game description]
